title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: fluxes.cpp and solver.cpp implement conservative compressible perfect-gas finite-volume terms with case-derived gas and viscosity controls.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads unstructured zones and 1-to-1 connectivity, merges zones and builds geometry; partition.cpp calls METIS on adjacency.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:684–914 reconstructs interior face states, assembles flux contributions and reduces residual norms; detailed convergence limitations are scored separately.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: fluxes.cpp:7 implements Rusanov; report.tex:229 accurately discloses this choice and identifies Roe/HLLC as future work. No entropy-fixed Roe is implemented.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp classifies farfield, slip and no-slip boundaries and uses wall stress; wall surface output represents boundary values. General independent BC validation is limited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:691–708 applies limiter and reconstructs interior faces; :1794–1913 implements gradient-based limiter. No formal smooth-order convergence test was established.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:1794–1913 computes Barth-type limiter and reconstruction; positivity safeguards apply to updates. Non-smooth force/residual tails remain.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fluxes.cpp viscous flux and solver.cpp:1438–1518 wall stresses exist; integrated split is full traction, expressly disclosed by report.tex:786–788, rather than tangential-only rubric split.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp uses LU-SGS/block-Jacobi paths and CFL controls; plateau criterion at :625–675 tests drag but not lift, leaving Re20 lift drift unrecognized.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:778–832 uses BDF2 total residual but accepts mere decrease as strict-target success; original last ratio 0.3696 against 0.001 and strict miss count unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor state/gradient exchanges exist, but main.cpp:89–119 retains full CGNS mesh on every rank throughout iterations.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
